structured_output.title: Vue 2 Migration Readiness Audit
structured_output.one_liner: A fixed-fee audit that estimates the cost and risk of migrating a Vue 2 codebase to Vue 3.
structured_output.target_customer: Engineering managers at 20-200 person companies still running Vue 2 in production
structured_output.job_to_be_done: Decide whether, when and at what cost to migrate off end-of-life Vue 2.
structured_output.current_workaround: A senior engineer spends a week guessing at an estimate, or the migration is postponed.
riskiest_assumptions: Companies will pay a third party for an estimate instead of doing it in-house.
A fixed-fee audit can be delivered in under a week of effort.
Audit buyers convert into migration contract buyers.
